thread:
Marta: Quick check — PR #4821 updates /v1/generate response shape to move model info into choices[].metadata.version and remove the top-level "model" field. Is that a breaking change for unpinned clients? I added the PR link: https://git.redwood/infra/pr/4821

Lina: If clients read top-level "model" it's breaking for sure. Do we still send an X-Model response header?

Sam: We do send X-Model for now. Gateway also supports an "Accept-Model" request header that prefers a model, and if absent we currently fall back to the default. PR introduces a temporary feature flag preserve_top_model for 2 weeks so existing clients keep getting the old shape.

Raj: Could we add a tiny compatibility shim on the API side that sets top-level "model" to choices[0].metadata.version when missing? That avoids client churn and is cheap. Pseudocode: 
```js
if (!resp.model) resp.model = resp.choices?.[0]?.metadata?.version || 'redwood-v1';
```

Marta: I like the shim as a short-term mitigation. We should still communicate the intended removal and a deprecation timeline — I'd prefer 14 days after merge, not 3. Also need to update SDKs and console docs.

ops-bot: CI passed for PR #4821 — unit tests ok, integration tests running. Canary deploy scheduled for 10% us-west.

Lina: Quick QA checklist I used: 
- call /v1/generate without Accept-Model and with old SDKs
- verify response contains top-level "model" for both canary and control
- check X-Model header and choices[0].metadata.version parity
- run token-compat smoke test on streaming responses

Sam: I'll add the shim in PR #4822 and open a small SDK patch to read choices[].metadata.version if top-level model absent. Also pinging @frontend to add a console banner that says "Model response shape will change in 14 days — pin models to avoid surprises".

Frontend Team Bot: Noted — banner draft created: "NOTICE: API response field "model" will be removed; please pin model via Accept-Model header or SDK config. Deprecation date: YYYY-MM-DD".

Marta: If nobody objects, I'll merge PR #4821 tomorrow EOD with the preserve_top_model flag on and the shim in a follow-up. Then start the 14-day deprecation notice and create the docs + changelog entry. Ping me if you want a shorter/longer window. :thumbsup:
